node.statement: For Z in M_n tensor S_P, the product upper axiom in that alpha-C*-algebra and the isometry of the inherited involution give ||Z^dagger dot Z||<=(1+alpha)||Z^dagger||||Z||=(1+C_ca*e)||Z||^2. If S_P=0, node 1.1.1 gives Z=0 and the same inequality trivially. Hence kappa:=C_ca and e_sq:=e_ca are universal witnesses for every H-CB datum and every n, which is precisely the amplified estimate invoked by node 1.1.3.
